title: Art & Galleries

questions.question: Do you enjoy visiting art galleries?
questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, I do, especially when I have a free afternoon. I like seeing how artists use colour and light, and a quiet gallery gives me time to look at each piece without feeling rushed.

questions.question: When did you last visit an art gallery?
questions.sampleAnswer: I went to a small gallery in my city a few months ago. It was hosting an exhibition by local artists, so I got to see paintings of familiar streets and landmarks from a completely different perspective.

questions.question: Would you like to have a painting in your home?
questions.sampleAnswer: Definitely. I would choose something simple and calming, perhaps a landscape in soft colours. It would make the room feel more personal, and I think original artwork can be a good conversation starter.
